text_block_list.text:
During her first three years in the Twinkle Series,
Mejiro Bright shone brilliantly—
proudly declaring that the Mejiro family was alive and well.

It was believed that she would go on to become an even more invincible Umamusume.
Or so everyone thought...
Reality—did not turn out that way.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Bright, so close!
She cut in from the inside, but couldn't reach, finishing in second!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Her finishing burst is undisputed!
However, the massive underdog pulls off an incredible upset!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
What happened to Mejiro Bright?!
She finishes in 5th! 5th place today!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Victory in this crucial match was not meant to be! The pace didn't favor them either.

She had her victories, but also many narrow defeats.
Some claimed she fell short
given her true potential, but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Trainer~, I am so sorry~.
Um~...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: I wonder what went wrong~?

Whenever she failed to win, the cause of defeat was clear.
Indeed...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Hawaaa... Acceleration...
choice_data_list: Because it's progressing even faster lately.

text_block_list.text: Mejiro Bright's greatest strength is, without a doubt, her late spurt in long-distance races.

With today's trend leaning toward medium distances
and a consistently fast pace,
it's quite difficult to achieve good results.

"To be honest, it was frustrating.
If there were more races suited for Mejiro Bright,
she'd be on a continuous winning streak by now."

The current Twinkle Series isn't optimal for Mejiro Bright.
I couldn't help but feel terribly sorry for her.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"If it's because of recent trends,
I would~... well, let's see~."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
There is no need to worry yourself too much.
That is what you mean, correct?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu, how wonderful~.
I feel a little more at ease now~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Of course it's frustrating~. I do know I need to be more resourceful, you know? But still~

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I have no intention of changing myself
just to match the trends. That is because...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
That might just be how things are right now,
but who knows how it will be 10 or 20 years from now,
don't you agree?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. What I am contemplating is
the distant future, long after
I have retired from racing.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Even if an era perfectly suited to my running were to come...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
If my running were lost to the Mejiro family by that time,
wouldn't that be a dreadful tragedy~?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"Change what needs changing, protect what needs protecting.
Without being swayed, we must carry on doing just that..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Because for a long time now, the Mejiro family has been unable to win the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, this is fine.
Just like this. After all, the present is not the top priority.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: There is Mejiro, and there is me, and time is at its very end...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I have never lost sight of it.
Even on the days of defeat, that far-off summit remains in my view.

I could only stand there in awe. This was the Mejiro perspective.
No—this was Mejiro Bright's perspective.

Yes, the important thing is—to believe in Mejiro Bright's
strength, hone it, and pass it on into the future.

To begin with, the race distances she runs are totally
different from other Umamusume.
Yes, Mejiro Bright is—

I am running a long-distance race called
'Uma Musume History'. A race longer than anyone else's.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, let us keep pursuing it
without ever giving up.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"It is quite fine if we cannot reach it right now.
For there is the Mejiro of the present, striving with all their might."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"Today's victor will surely smile.
And that is wonderful in its own right."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
“There is something faaar more wonderful
than that, you know?”

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Even a hundred years from now, no matter how much
the Twinkle Series changes form...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
The ones who will emerge victorious then—
shall be us.
